title: Read a NRRD volume
description: Read a NRRD volume as slices by flattened voxels.

slice_start.title: First slice
slice_start.description: Zero-based index of the first z slice to read.

slice_stop.title: Stop slice
slice_stop.description: Exclusive upper z slice index; null reads to the last slice.

max_cells.title: Maximum voxels
max_cells.description: Reject volumes whose requested slice range exceeds this many voxels.
